description: Set up any game to play in this chat: board games, card games, dice games, word and guessing games, mysteries. Describe it with the building blocks below, or pass starter for a ready one (tic-tac-toe, four-in-a-row, gomoku, checkers, reversi, crazy-eights, go-fish, twenty-one, pig, sea-battle, hangman, twenty-questions). The server keeps the board, deals and hides cards, rolls dice and enforces turns, so the player can trust the game. The player gets an interactive board in the chat (and a link to play in a browser or invite friends). Returns game_id and agent_key; keep both for get_state and take_turn. You run the rules that aren't built in.

about.description: The rules in a few sentences, shown to the player. Write them so you can follow them too.

counters.description: Scores and tallies: "score", or {name, per_seat: false, start}.

deal.description: Cards dealt to each hand at the start.

deck.description: "standard" (52, ids like AS, 10H, QC), "standard_jokers", "numbers:1-10x4", or a list of card labels or {label, suit, rank}. Adds a face-down deck, a face-up table and a hidden hand per seat.

owner.description: Seat name, or omit for neutral.

rules.description: Rules the server enforces for you.

one_move.description: A place, move or play ends the turn by itself.

seats.description: Players in turn order. Default: Player (human) then Agent (agent).

piece.description: What a click on an empty cell places for this seat.

starter.description: A ready-made game. Other fields here override its setup (for example seats).

turns.description: alternate (default): one seat at a time. free: anyone acts anytime (guessing games, puzzles).

name: create_game
title: Create a game
